parameters.name: BusinessType
parameters.description:
The log type of real-time logs. Valid values:

- **dcdn_log_access_l1 (default)**: access logs.
- **dcdn_log_er**: Edge Routine logs.
- **dcdn_log_waf**: security protection logs.
- **dcdn_log_ipa**: Layer 4 acceleration logs.

parameters.name: FieldName
parameters.description: The list of delivery fields to modify, separated by commas.

parameters.name: FilterVer
parameters.description:
The version of the filter rule.

> Compatible with legacy filter rules. The default value is v1. Newly created rules use v2.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.
